summary: Ran the probe that answers the one remaining derived consequence of the no-snapshot variant, and re-registered that gap. The new harness (assurance_empty_config_vote_test.go, validated as update.json against question 16929a65…-question-0 with 7 comparisons over 6 events) asks an outside candidate for a vote from the same node twice: while it still holds the committed {A,B,C} the identical request is refused (response_granted false, no leader known, candidate absent from the configuration), and after a Config.RestoreCommittedLogs restart with no snapshot the node holds an empty configuration and grants the vote, adopting the candidate's term. It then supplies a real node X whose log records the configuration {A,X}, so X reaches Leader on the strength of that one grant while the node follows it and its own committed log still names {A,B,C}, with the cluster's leader B still in place — two leaders at once. Locally the harness passed four times with identical operands (X leader at term 5, node follower of X, log 13→14), and validation confirmed only benign effects: a gaps update on the question plus one experiment creation. The receipt will be interpreted on the next step.
